candidate.label: Mature Temperate Oak · Meshy 6 R1
candidate.prompt: One complete mature English oak tree, botanically believable at human scale. A stout tapered trunk rises from one coherent modest radial root flare, then divides into clearly separated primary limbs; every limb and secondary branch tapers naturally and visibly connects. The broad asymmetric crown has many distinct airy leaf sprays and uneven branch-end clusters separated by large sky windows, never a spherical or fused canopy. Full tree from root tips to crown, isolated game asset, no ground disk, rocks, vines, moss, props, or background.
candidate.texturePrompt: Photorealistic dry English oak. Trunk and every visible branch are unmistakable brown-gray bark with deep vertical furrows and restrained warm brown in the creases; zero green tint, algae, moss, or lichen. Leaves alone vary naturally among deep forest green, muted mid-green, and restrained fresh green, with darker interior clusters. Neutral diffuse daylight albedo with no baked highlights or shadows. Clean nonmetallic high-roughness PBR, subtle bark and leaf normals, no emission, no wet gloss.
